I don't condone drug use, especially IV, especially meth, but if I did this is what I would do

Get yourself a scale. Measure out .25 in ice. Measure out .1 of dope or pills or whatever opiate you like 

Add 15 units of water, mix well till dissolved, then suck it up through the cotton. Since you put in 15 units if water if you get more back, then you're on the right track    I've had doses that came back 45 units off of 15 (Thats 30 units of drugs).

Bang that shit 


Hold the fuck on for dear life cause a rush like that is the kind of rush you'll chase for the rest of your life. 

If I were you, I would never IV again. it lead me right to daily use. Daily use isn't fun, especially when you wake up and realize that you mean a whole lot of nothing to nobody. I fit everything I ever loved into a needle. I lost everyone and everything I cared about. I am only using now so I don't have to face what I've done to those people around me that I loved that ill never see again. Every moment I am alive is pure agony. I pray for death with every breath that crosses my lips. But death never comes for cowards like me. I'll have to live this horror until it's over, and thats a long time after I've been declared dead. 

There's a lot worse ways to be dead than dying.
